user.title: New fan
user.description: Name the fan and pick the fan entity to use. The backup fan, the light, the timer, the speeds and the remotes are set afterwards, from the integration's Configure button.

data_description.fan_entity: The fan used as long as it is available, typically the local integration.
data_description.fallback_fan_entity: Takes over while the main fan is unavailable, typically the cloud integration.

error.same_fan: The backup fan must be a different entity.

menu.title: FanBridge
menu.description:
Nothing is saved before “Save”: closing this dialog with ✕ drops the changes.

Remote buttons: {remote_count}

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: For each role, the main entity is used while it is available and the backup one takes over otherwise. Leave a role empty if the fan has none.

speeds.title: Speed percentages
speeds.description: For fans whose reported steps do not match their real speeds (a cloud integration reporting 100 steps for 6 speeds, for example). Give the percentage of each speed, lowest first, e.g. 1, 21, 41, 60, 80, 100: strictly increasing, 1 to 100, at most {max} values. Leave empty to use the fan's own steps.

remote_add.title: Add a remote button
remote_add.description: Pick where the press comes from, what it sends, and what it does. For a Zigbee2MQTT remote use its MQTT topic (zigbee2mqtt/REMOTE_NAME/action) or its action sensor / event entity, and the action name as payload (e.g. 1_single).

error.same_fan: The backup fan must be a different entity.
error.invalid_speeds: Give strictly increasing whole percentages from 1 to 100, separated by commas.
